data.body: Classification: behavioral, Score: 2 (BASIC). Root cause identified: _offer_worktree_cleanup and is_branch_merged only check local 'main' ref, not 'origin/main'. When the main repo is checked out on a non-main branch, git pull does not fast-forward local main. Worktree created from a branch that has commits present in origin/main but not local main → is-ancestor check fails → false 'unmerged commits' report. Fix: add origin/main fallback to is-ancestor check in both claude-safe and worktree-cleanup.sh.
